tuning_key.text: Who are they? I wonder what they could be? / Who will help them see... If you won't?
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: Gratitude softens your attention until the people around you reveal themselves not as fixed forms but as unfolding possibilities. You become the mirror they did not ask for yet desperately need—your steady presence the light that makes their becoming visible, even to themselves.

practice.title: Root in the Warmth
practice.instruction: Feel your breath slow until gratitude pools as a physical warmth behind your sternum, settling your weight wherever you are.

practice.title: Widen the Frame
practice.instruction: Lift your gaze to horizon height and allow shapes around you to blur into potential, letting each person reveal who they could become without fixing them.

practice.title: Become the Reflection
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo and let your shoulders drop as you become the reflection that helps them see—brightness expanding simply by witnessing.
